items.html: The second head, which is called the air, has in it also three names of the name SAG, also in exactly the aforementioned manner. And in the aforementioned vowels, like this: Yod-He, Vav, Hey [inner light]; Yod-He-Yod, Vav-He-Vav, Hey-Yod [first surrounding]; Yod-Yod, Hey-Yod, Vav-He-Vav, Hey-Yod [upper surrounding], except that in place of every Tzere point there is a Segol point in their place. And all three of them — inner light, surrounding, and surrounding of both of them — are in the aspect of particularity. But in relation to the generality, all these three discernments are only the aspect of the small surrounding light upon the inner, and it is Ruach.
